name: bison_rider
description: a Doviello Bison Rider, a barbarian in a grey wolf-head pelt hood and a shaggy grey-and-cream fur cloak with a bone-tooth necklace, blue war paint over his eye and leather wraps, a round wooden shield slung on his back and a long wooden spear with a steel head and white feather tassels couched in his RIGHT hand, riding a huge shaggy dark-brown bison with a hump, curved cream horns, a rope halter and dark hooves
hands: the long spear stays couched in the rider's right hand on the screen-left side, its point far out to the right; his left hand is hidden behind the bison's hump and the shield stays slung on his back
